title: Native Charters

services.name: Permit Charters
services.desc: Experience the thrill of permit fishing in the pristine waters of Key West and the Lower Keys with Captain Chris Duncan as your expert guide. Navigating the picturesque surroundings of Cudjoe Key, Sugarloaf Key, Big Coppitt Key, and Summerland Key, Captain Duncan invites you to join him for an unforgettable permit fishing charter that combines skill, strategy, and the natural beauty of the Lower Keys. Captain Duncan is your seasoned captain and permit fishing expert, blending local knowledge with a passion for this challenging and sought-after angling pursuit. With years of experience navigating the flats and channels of the Lower Keys, he provides an unparalleled permit fishing experience
